name: Glorious Obscenity

effects.name: Enhanced Spot
effects.tooltip: Enhanced Spot +5 : Passive: +5 Enhancement bonus to the Spot skill.

effects.name: Seeker
effects.tooltip: Seeker +6 : Provides a +6 Enhancement bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +6 Enhancement bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).

effects.name: Mind Turbulence
effects.tooltip: Mind Turbulence : This item fills your mind with chaos, disrupting your thoughts and causing a -10 Concentration penalty.

effects.name: Taint of Chaos
effects.tooltip: Taint of Chaos : Lawful aligned characters equipping this item suffer a temporary negative level until the item is removed.

effects.name: Rune Arm Imbue : Acid
effects.tooltip: Rune Arm Imbue : Acid IV: Wearing this Rune Arm will imbue any weapon you wield, dealing 2d8 points of acid damage per hit.

effects.name: Craftable Rune Arm
effects.tooltip: This Rune Arm is craftable and can be customized using recipes at standard crafting devices after disjuncting.

flavor_text: Carved into this rune arm is the phrase 'Call me crazy again and I'll eat your other eye'.
notes: You can remove the Mind Turbulence penalty with a Sustaining Symbiont . When disjuncted for Essence Crafting, retains Mind Turbulence and Taint of Chaos, loses Seeker and Enhanced Spot The following image shows what the Runearm looks like after being disjuncted in a post-U32 Item Deconstruction machine.
